navi.name: Anika - Animated, Friendly and Engaging
navi.description: Anika is a trusted friend - expressive, clear, and effortlessly engaging. Perfect for animated storytelling or tutorials, it brings an optimistic, authentic tone that connects with young listeners and makes every word resonate. Ideal for projects that need an empathetic, friendly touch.

saria.name: Ayres - Warm, Gentle and Soothing
saria.description: Warm, gentle female voice perfect for audiobooks, storytelling, and YouTube content. Natural and soothing tone with clear articulation, ideal for educational videos, narrative content, and engaging listeners of all ages. Versatile delivery that brings stories to life with authenticity and emotional depth.

arvore_deku.name: James - Deep, Raspy and Grim
arvore_deku.description: A very low, deep, and raspy voice with a UK accent. Perfect for audiobooks as well as narrations or characters for films, video games, documentaries, and even YouTube/TikTok stories.

mido.name: Beto - Native Brazilian Specialist (PT-BR)
mido.description: Authentic Native Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) with a Neutral Accent (São Paulo). Professional, deep, and trustworthy. Optimized for YouTube (Finance, True Crime, Tech), Localization, and Corporate Training. Delivers a mature "storyteller" pacing for high audience retention.

zelda_crianca.name: Dara de Alcantara - Soft and Shy

zelda_adulta.name: Amanda Kelly - Sweet, Warm and Clear
zelda_adulta.description: A sweet, feminine, and youthful Brazilian Portuguese voice with a neutral accent. Naturally warm and expressive, she brings a gentle charm to every word. Ideal for narrations, educational content, and conversational dialogue where clarity, softness, and an inviting tone are essential.

sheik.name: Charles - Social Media, TV & Commercial
sheik.description: A bold, charismatic male voice that brings energy, clarity, and authenticity to every project. Perfect for creators, brands, and storytellers who want to connect with modern audiences through powerful, relatable narration. Charles delivers a natural conversational tone that fits seamlessly across every corner of social media — from quick-hit Shorts and TikToks to long-form storytelling and branded campaigns.

ganondorf.name: Miguel - Deep, Emotional & Cinematic
ganondorf.description: Deep Brazilian voice with cinematic emotion, soulful storytelling, and a warm gravely tone perfect for drama, audiobooks, emotional narration, and immersive characters.

rauru.name: Spuds Oxley - Grandpa
rauru.description: A friendly Southern grandpa who knows how to enthrall his audience with tall tales and fun adventures! A warm, friendly, stylized baritone voice that is great for these categories: characters, educational, advertisement, social media, conversational, and entertainment.

impa.name: Andrea Lot - authoritative Brazilian Portuguese voice
impa.description: A rich, deep, and authoritative Brazilian Portuguese voice, specialized in long-form narration and storytelling. With a naturally calm and resonant tone, this voice is perfect for high-end documentaries, educational content, scientific explanations, and immersive audiobooks.

darunia.name: Chris Basetta - Warm, Deep and Engaging
darunia.description: Middle aged warm and calm, voice.  ideal for audiobooks and narrations. You can also use it in English, choosing the American accent for perfect pronunciation.

ruto_crianca.name: Marianne - Customer service
ruto_crianca.description: A young, professional female voice in Brazilian Portuguese, designed for customer service agents. Versatile for support, sales, collections, and virtual assistants—featuring an empathetic, assertive, and natural tone.

ruto_adulta.name: Hope - Professional, Clear and Natural
ruto_adulta.description: A calm, confident, and authoritative voice with clear enunciation—ideal for corporate trainings, tutorials, and IVRs.

rei_zora.name: Joe - Confident Idiot
rei_zora.description: Uneducated, oblivious male. Endlessly opinionated. Great for blunt, rude, annoying and incorrect content. American male. A funny voice by Hey Its Brad.

nabooru.name: Larisa Actrisa - Confident and Clear
nabooru.description: Young Russian female with a gentle voice, perfect for social media use case.

kaepora_gaebora.name: Will - Deep, Smooth and Affectionate
kaepora_gaebora.description: Narration voice for Brazilian children, with a friendly and warm touch. Designed to capture the attention of children, it has smooth and expressive intonations. Ideal for audiobooks, children's stories, and educational content.

malon_crianca.name: Graziella - Children's Narrator
malon_crianca.description: Perfect for children, this clear Brazilian voice has a youthful, lively tone that is ideal for storytelling. Expressive and dynamic, it brings fantasy, fairytale, and other characters to life, creating a magical listening experience. It is also well suited for children’s e-learning content, presenting educational material in a friendly, easy-to-follow, and captivating way.

malon_adulta.name: Marianne - Sweet, Calm and Clear
malon_adulta.description:
A young Brazilian female with a sweet, calm voice and neutral accent.
Specialized on media (youtube, instagram, memes, tiktok, etc) and storytelling/narration (books, articles, news, dubbing, etc).

talon.name: Tarun - Rich, Warm and Friendly
talon.description: This voice has a lively rich timber which elevates the brand communication. The Indian neutral accent is ideal for both, the urban sophisticated youth and the hinterland go getter. A comforting resonance coupled with an elegant delivery that captivates listeners and audiences whilst bringing the client’s message home so as to achieve the intended outcome.

ingo.name: Vagner de Souza - Sharp and Sarcastic
ingo.description: Middle aged male Portuguese voice. Suitable for different jobs, such as: dubbing, narration, and tutorials.

koume.name: Kassandra  - Strange and Tricky
koume.description:
The voice of the Oracle - Kassandras voice carries the weight of an extraordinary life – sometimes warm and grandmotherly, then razor-sharp and bitingly sarcastic.
Perfect for mysterious mentor figures, urban fantasy, wise eccentrics with dark pasts, or any role that combines wisdom with world-weariness and unexpected truths with a touch of cynicism.

kotake.name: Regina - Meditative, Expressive, Soft
kotake.description: Female mature voice. Calm and Deep. Perfect for audiobooks.

vendedor_mascaras.name: Manoel - Serious & Elegant
vendedor_mascaras.description: The voice of a serious professional.

dampe.name: Nunessilva
dampe.description:
A 52-year-old professional with a degree in Philosophy from USP and a specialization in Corporate Communication from FGV. His career spans 25 years as an executive.

Vocal Profile: Medium-low pitch with chest resonance. Full-bodied voice, natural rather than forced | Moderate pace (140–155 words per minute). Strategic pauses of 1–3 seconds after key points |
Steady, with subtle variations for emphasis. No abrupt fluctuations; precise diction. Every syllable is fully articulated.

guru_guru.name: Krishna - Energetic and Expressive
guru_guru.description: Krishna is the pen name of a very talented actor, director, and casting director. Because of his experience both on and off screen, he has a 360-degree view of how a voice should be. You will notice that range and professionalism in his voice. Do give it a try.

grande_fada.name: Iris - Warm, Soothing and Emotional
grande_fada.description: "Iris Romantic" is a soothing voice full of passion and sincere, very human and feminine. Perfect for narrations and conveying emotions.

skull_kid.name: Zozo
skull_kid.description: An animated, expressive, and cheerful voice. Perfect for video game adventure videos!

biggoron.name: W.L. Oxley
biggoron.description: A typical American adult male whose baritone voice is understandable, conversational, honest, and direct. Also great for these categories: characters, narration, educational, advertisement, social media, and entertainment.

narrador.name: David - Deep, Gravelly and Resonnat
narrador.description: Middle-aged man with deep, gravelly voice, special for trailers and epic narrations.

broto_arvore_deku.name: Weverton - Youthful, Energetic and Clear
broto_arvore_deku.description: Young male voice, useful for books or audio description.

link_goron.name: Adam - Engaging, Friendly and Bright
link_goron.description:
Adam is a male voice, 20s–30s, blends clarity, and confident expression. Ideal for creators and brands who want their content to feel real, relatable, and human.

Trained across multiple formats including storytelling, ads, social media, tutorials, and casual dialogue, Adam adapts seamlessly to your tone.

Whether guiding, selling, or narrating, Adam builds trust, relatability, and connection from the very first word.

Friendly, grounded, expressive -ready to elevate your content

medigoron.name: Will - Dramatic, Expressive and Resonant
medigoron.description: Young Brazilian male narrator. It's a medium-deep voice, casual style, perfect for dramatic stories, podcasting, and modern institutional videos.

vendedor_feijoes.name: Manav - Charming, Husky and Warm
vendedor_feijoes.description:
A rich, husky voice with effortless charm—perfect for engaging narrations, voice assistants, and romantic storytelling.

Manav’s tone is smooth yet grounded, ideal for dating apps, audiobooks, interactive AI agents, and brand campaigns looking for a confident Indian male voice with emotional depth. Great fit for platforms like Spotify, Audible, YouTube, and chatbot-driven content that requires charisma and relatability.

homem_pescaria.name: Jay Wayne - Wise University Professor
homem_pescaria.description: A confident, semi-deep, middle-aged male voice with a natural Texas tone. Warm, grounded, and versatile—ideal for commercial spec ads, narrative storytelling, and conversational marketing. This voice strikes the perfect balance between professional and relatable, making it suitable for brand messaging, explainer videos, and laid-back yet persuasive narration.

cientista_lago.name: Sergio - Deep, Resonant and Clear
cientista_lago.description:
A Senior Brazilian voice — Powerful, Deep, Decisive, and Serious. 
Ideal for narrations, headlines, documentaries, films, characters, and YouTube videos.

gerudo_guerreira.name: Ana Dias - Engaging, Smooth and Forceful
gerudo_guerreira.description: Slightly deep female voice, ideal for different types of content. The recordings were made reading a book, ensuring a fluid and engaging narration. The voice is perfect for news channels on YouTube, bringing seriousness and clarity to reports, for audiobooks, bringing books to life with captivating narration, and for other content such as podcasts and institutional videos. If you are looking for a voice that conveys confidence and professionalism, this is the right choice for your projects.

gerudo_segunda_comando.name: Alcione - Soft, Energetic and Tender
gerudo_segunda_comando.description: A young female, soft voice. Great for Narrations.

dama_cucco.name: Ana Alice - Friendly & Clear
dama_cucco.description: A clear and pleasant Brazilian Portuguese voice. Friendly and relatable, it is perfect for engaging social media, YouTube and TikTok videos, podcasts, and educational content. Your audience will love the casual, inviting tone of this voice.

homem_skulltula.name: Raju - Clear, Natural and Warm
homem_skulltula.description: This voice has the familiar warmth and approachability of a regular Indian speaker, yet it carries a professionalism that makes it versatile for a range of applications. It's clear and articulate enough to engage audiences on social media, provide guidance through customer care bots, and serve in various other communication roles. Its authentic Indian tone adds a layer of relatability without compromising on clarity or effectiveness, making it an excellent choice for connecting with audiences.

porteiro_montanha.name: Adam - warm and friendly
porteiro_montanha.description: Authentic, deep, Québec French Canadian male voice, perfect for teaching, e-learning, and information sharing. Warm, friendly, and engaging tone.

fado.name: Callie - Playful, Inviting and Friendly
fado.description: Friendly, approachable, optimistic, and sweet! Slight dry tone! Callie can be used for anything!

flat.name: Márcio
flat.description: Brazilian, with a deep, masculine voice. Perfect for storytelling, solemn narrations, movie trailers, and anything else your creativity and imagination can come up with.

sharp.name: Tarquin - Posh & English RP
sharp.description: A posh British man from the Home Counties. Landed gentry. Received Pronunciation.

avo_pocoes.name: Mia - Teacher
avo_pocoes.description: She is a Neutral Spanish Teacher and Trainer . This Character works great for E learnings and dynamic communications ;) Try her in hour animation videos

colecionador_poe.name: Leon Stern - Rich and Deep
colecionador_poe.description: A rich, deep voice for fantasy and epic adventure novels that captivates listeners until the very last second.

corredor.name: Will - Dynamic, Deep and Articulate
corredor.description: Brazilian man with a São Paulo accent, salesperson, great for VSL, extra income niche, dynamic speaker, articulate, also excellent for social media.

professor_shikashi.name: Timothy Twilight - Calm and Soothing
professor_shikashi.description: Timothy Twilight is a very calm, gentle, and soothing voice – perfect for bringing novels to life or guiding listeners into peaceful goodnight stories. With its soft and pleasant tone, this voice creates a warm and comforting atmosphere that draws listeners in. Whether used for audiobooks, bedtime tales, radio, or podcasts, Timothy Twilight carries a sense of ease and elegance that makes every word feel natural and serene.

dono_tiro_ao_alvo.name: Fernando Martínez - Rapid, Persuasive
dono_tiro_ao_alvo.description: Middle aged casual male voice. Ideal for narrations.

operadora_boliche_bombchu.name: Carla - Playful, Spirited and Fun
operadora_boliche_bombchu.description: A young, energetic Brazilian female voice full of enthusiasm! Perfect for kids' content on YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Carla is the fun host who loves to play, tell stories, and create exciting challenges with high energy. Great for entertaining children with creativity, joy, and imagination!

dono_bazaar.name: Eduardo Hubi - Melancholic and Calm
dono_bazaar.description: Calm male voice, conveying credibility and truth.

dono_loja_bombchu.name: Ruhaan - Clear and Confident
dono_loja_bombchu.description: Ruhaan is a pen name of an Indian artist who has spent decades in front of the camera. You will see that experience in his voice, which is beautiful for creating ads, social media content, audiobooks. His English voice is already loved by thousands on ElevenLabs.

dono_loja_pocoes.name: Marcelo Costa - Articulate and Balanced
dono_loja_pocoes.description: Middle aged, Brazilian, male and pleasant voice. Great for narration, storytelling, Youtube, commercials and other digital needs.

gerente_bau_tesouro.name: Nicolas Petit - Convincing and Bright
gerente_bau_tesouro.description: A middle aged male French voice. Journalist voice for story or audio article. Great for reading News.

mercador_tapete.name: Adolpho Azevedo - Laid-Back and Bright
mercador_tapete.description: Best Brazilian voice in the Brazilian Market, from movies and series!

pierre.name: Anton - Formal and Strong
pierre.description: A voice with a deep, resonant baritone that carries a sense of gravity and intensity. The tone is rich and full-bodied. It possesses an underlying tension that is perfect for thriller and true crime recordings. Standard German, no accent.

twinrova.name: Jessica Anne Bogart - Eloquent Villain
twinrova.description: The Villain! Wickedly eloquent. Calculating. Cruel and calm.

npc_masculino.name: A.Medeiros - Clear, Calm & Friendly
npc_masculino.description: Casual and authentic male voiceover. A friendly, conversational tone—free of dramatic exaggeration. Excellent for podcasts, straightforward script narration, and automated social media videos.

npc_feminino.name: Marianne - Customer service
npc_feminino.description: A young, professional Brazilian Portuguese female voice designed for customer service agents. Versatile enough for support, sales, collections, and virtual assistants—delivering an empathetic, assertive, and natural tone.
